description_en: Creates an Edge Node Service (ENS) security group rule
kebab_example: aliyun ens create-security-group-permissions --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --permissions Policy=Accept PortRange=80/80 Description=testDescription SourcePortRange=22/22 Priority=1 SourceCidrIp=0.0.0.0/0 IpProtocol=TCP DestCidrIp=10.XX.XX.14/32 Ipv6SourceCidrIp=::/0 Ipv6DestCidrIp=::/0 Direction=ingress --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSecurityGroupPermissions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
parameters.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The description of the security group rule. It must be 2 to 256 characters long and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
描述信息。
长度为2~256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The destination IPv4 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 目的端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The traffic direction for the rule. Valid values:

`egress`: Outgoing traffic.

`ingress`: Incoming traffic
fields.help_zh:
授权方向。
egress：出方向。
ingress：入方向
fields.name: direction

fields.help_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:

`TCP`

`UDP`

`ICMP`

`ICMPv6`

`ALL`: All protocols
fields.help_zh:
协议类型。取值范围： 
         
TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
ICMP：ICMP协议。
ICMPv6：IPv6的ICMP协议。
ALL：支持所有协议
fields.name: ip_protocol

fields.help_en:
The destination IPv6 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv6 addresses.

This parameter and `DestCidrIp` are mutually exclusive
fields.help_zh:
目的端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。 

该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置
fields.name: ipv6_dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv6 addresses.

This parameter and `SourceCidrIp` are mutually exclusive
fields.help_zh:
源端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。
该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置
fields.name: ipv6_source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The access control policy. Valid values:

`Accept`: Allows matching traffic.

`Drop`: Denies matching traffic and drops the packets
fields.help_zh:
访问权限。取值范围： 
         
Accept：接受访问。
Drop：拒绝访问
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en:
The destination port range for the rule.

For TCP and UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports. For example, `1/200`.

For ICMP, the value must be `-1/-1`.

For ICMPv6, the value must be `-1/-1`.

If you set `IpProtocol` to `ALL`, the value must be `-1/-1`
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的目的端口范围。取值范围：
         
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
ICMPv6：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
fields.name: port_range

fields.help_en: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: 安全组规则优先级，数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1~100
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The source IPv4 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The source port range for the rule.

For TCP and UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports. For example, `1/200`.

For ICMP, the value must be `-1/-1`.

For ICMPv6, the value must be `-1/-1`.

If you set `IpProtocol` to `ALL`, the value must be `-1/-1`
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的源端口范围。取值范围：
         
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
ICMPv6：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
fields.name: source_port_range

parameters.help_en: A collection of security group rule objects
parameters.name: permissions
